title: Geometric-point product sheaves: adjunction, exactness and evaluation acyclicity
statement:
Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $R$ a commutative ring, and $P$ any small indexed family of geometric points of $X$, in the universes of [def-weil-size-convention]. Use ordinary small-etale $R_X$-module sheaves [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], geometric stalks [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks], and nonnegative injective resolutions [def-sp-injective-resolutions]. For a family of $R$-modules $M=(M_p)_{p\in P}$ define the presheaf
$$B_P(M)(V)=\prod_{p\in P}\prod_{v:p\to V}M_p$$
on etale $V\to X$, with restriction by precomposition on the lift index and maps induced coordinatewise. This presheaf is a sheaf. The functor $B_P$ is right adjoint to the exact functor $A_P:F\mapsto(F_p)_{p\in P}$, with unit the tuple of germ maps. For every etale $V\to X$, the functor $M\mapsto B_P(M)(V)$ is exact; in particular $B_P$ is exact. If each $M_p$ is injective as an $R$-module, $B_P(M)$ is an injective $R_X$-module sheaf. Every family $M$ admits a family of nonnegative injective module resolutions $M_p\to J_p^\bullet$, and applying $B_P$ degreewise gives an injective sheaf resolution $B_P(M)\to B_P(J^\bullet)$. For every etale $V\to X$ and integer $a>0$,
$$R^a\Gamma(V,-)(B_P(M))=0,$$
where $\Gamma(V,-)$ is evaluation on $V$ and its right derived functors are taken in the category of $R_X$-module sheaves [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology]. No conservativity of $P$, finiteness of $R$ or $M_p$, or Noetherian hypothesis on $X$ is assumed.

from.place: Proof Step 3: dimension-normalized Verdier duality, regular finite-torsion local model; pointwise purity and composition used to compare the normalized curve with the ambient regular scheme. Input: Gabber purity for a regular Noetherian closed pair. More precisely: Expose XVI, Proposition 3.3.2, printed p.245: compatible Godement cocycles for the fundamental classes and triangles C(mu) -> C(mu+nu) -> C(nu); coefficient compatibility of Proposition 3.3.1. Technical input for the Godement construction: supported exact resolution of arbitrary finite-coefficient sheaves, before any fundamental class is chosen. Building block: geometric-point direct-image products, before iterating the germ-unit resolution.
